verdict.rationale: Unleash documents reusable segments: collections of strategy constraints defined once and reused across any number of flags. Constraints are built on context fields with operators (shown with currentTime/DATE_AFTER), activation strategies target specific users, and strategy variants serve different versions to users. A dated community remark that Unleash's rules were 'more limited' is vague and hedged ('last I checked, some time ago'), so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documentation of the full set of user-attribute operators (only a date constraint example is shown), explicit linkage of segments to variant assignment, independent hands-on corroboration of attribute targeting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation

citations.quote: A segment is a reusable collection of strategy constraints... you can define a segment once and reuse it across any number of feature flags
Add a date-based constraint by selecting the `currentTime` context field (step 1 in the below image), choosing the `DATE_AFTER` operator
They allow you to enable and disable features for certain users without having to redeploy your application.
Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.
